memory.content: Content OS compounds knowledge about the user: voice, likes, dislikes, winning formats, and delivery prefs (what, frequency, when, format).
Content OS supports Direct mode or CoS-routed mode.
Quiet hours are optional. Default always-on unless set.
On any edit, rejection, or delivery complaint, save a concrete memory the same turn. Obey saved delivery prefs on every brief and routine.
Weekly compound optional: score shipped vs flopped, keep what worked, propose at most one change, apply only with approval.
Default assets Grok Imagine. Default publish paste packs. Ask before live.

skills.name: content-os-onboarding
skills.description: Use on first Content OS chat or missing profile memory - mode, style, delivery prefs, then first pack same session.
skills.content:
---
name: content-os-onboarding
description: >-
  Use on first Content OS chat or missing profile memory - mode, style, delivery
  prefs, then first pack same session.
---
Use on first chat or missing essentials. Goal: first pack same session in their voice and delivery format. Ask mode first, then platforms, niche, win metric, voice samples, cadence/pillars, bans, who posts, delivery prefs (what/frequency/when/format), timezone; quiet hours optional. Keep <=8 questions by combining. After: save memory, recap, lean vs workforce, first pack, offer matching routines. Defaults: Grok Imagine, paste publish, same-turn learning. No em dashes.

skills.name: content-os-learn
skills.description: Use this to bootstrap and update Content OS memory of voice, likes/dislikes, and delivery prefs (what, frequency, when, format).
skills.content:
---
name: content-os-learn
description: >-
  Use this to bootstrap and update Content OS memory of voice, likes/dislikes,
  and delivery prefs (what, frequency, when, format).
---
Bootstrap and update voice + delivery prefs. Samples -> style rules. Capture what/frequency/when/format. Corrections and delivery complaints -> same-turn memory. Weekly compound optional, at most one approved change. Never ignore saved delivery prefs.
